entries.note: The sender's system sent the consignment's details; the parcel has not reached TNT.
A depot's scan, at origin, on the way or at the delivering depot.
Back at the delivering depot at the end of a round that did not deliver it, after a carded attempt.
Followed by depot scans until the receiver collected the parcel: it does not go out until someone gives another address.
The receiver collected the parcel from the depot that held it, after its address was found wanting. The sender's pickup is "We've collected your shipment".
A delivery booking asked for at the delivering depot, after a carded attempt; it moves nothing.
Seen hours after the delivery it was for; it moves nothing.
Dated at the booked day's close, days ahead of the page's other scans; it moves nothing.
